issues.field: Assertion that the extracted observations verify the complete station count
issues.requirement: The observations cited as verification must establish coverage of the interval between South Station and Windsor Gardens to support an exact count.

evidence.quote: The viewport shows 40% of the webpage, and is positioned at the top of the page.
This is all visible text and labels from the provided image of the website page.
South Station is not shown in the extracted portion
Verification of the stops and count is complete

issues.rationale: The extraction explicitly reports a partial visible portion, and the target acknowledges that South Station is absent from that portion. Counting six listed stations establishes the size of that selected list, but the recorded extraction does not establish that it exhausts the requested interval. The claim that these observations complete verification exceeds their documented scope.

rationale: The target attributes verification of an exact interval count to observations explicitly limited to a partial extraction. This support-attribution failure is established without determining the external true count or assuming that the published history contains the actor's full context.
limitations: The external true station count is not established or evaluated.
The original full actor payload and system prompt are not verified; the diagnosis concerns attribution to the recorded extraction.
